annotations.title: Transliterate Church Slavonic to scientific Latin

description:
Render Church Slavonic — Cyrillic or Glagolitic — in the scientific
Latin transliteration Wiktionary uses (богъ → bogŭ, ⰱⱁⰳⱏ → bogŭ).
Liturgical reading marks (titlos, accents) are dropped and late Church
Slavonic spellings folded, so copied liturgical text works as-is. Returns
Markdown plus the transliterated output as structuredContent matching the
declared outputSchema. Pure local transform: no dictionary lookup and no
network.

text.description: Church Slavonic text to transliterate — Cyrillic and/or Glagolitic, one word or whole lines. Liturgical reading marks (titlos, accents, breathings) are dropped and late Church Slavonic spellings folded, so text copied from a liturgical source or a lyrics sheet works as-is.
text.title: Text

name: slavonic_transliterate

outputSchema.description:
The MCP-facing transliteration payload: the Latin output only. ``original``
is deliberately absent — like the Markdown render (see
:func:`~livonian.languages.slavonic.render.transliteration_to_markdown`), the
MCP result reaches an LLM's context, so the raw caller text must not be echoed
through it. The JSON API's :class:`Transliteration` keeps the echo for
programmatic callers.
outputSchema.title: TransliteratedText
